title: RealSafe-R1: Safety-Aligned DeepSeek-R1 without Compromising Reasoning Capability
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and utilizes specific safety benchmarks (StrongREJECT, XSTest, and WildChat) to evaluate the model's ability to recognize and refuse unethical, harmful, or illegal queries. This constitutes a direct evaluation of the model's alignment with ethical and moral standards.
